scope.definition: EX-06 ("AI/worker") is ONE row of LIVE Master Plan section 5.4 (heading "Predloženi radni paketi", i.e. a plan-proposed work unit, not an owner-approved scope): deliverable "Korpus, review, canonical grupe, matching, dispatch"; precondition "Ne šalje se novi paid test bez dogovorenog budžeta"; measure "Trajne činjenice zaista vode relevantnom obaveštenju." EX labels are work units inside the existing plan, not a tracker (plan 5.4 intro); output is recorded in existing control rows (AGENTS section 2). The detailed contract lives under the P5 name: plan chapter 12 (12.1 one AI mechanism, 12.2 fact ownership, 12.3 canonical groups, 12.4 hard eligibility then ranking, 12.5 dispatch + DONE, 12.6 an elaboration that the plan itself says is NOT a claim of implementation), PLAN.md sections 3-4, runbook P5 (+P4 item 6 for the opportunity-push event), cards A02/B00-B03/P04 and scenarios J03/J15. Concretely EX-06 means: (1) KORPUS - a local/offline contract corpus of safe examples with expected structured facts, reported honestly (size, failures, untested categories); (2) REVIEW - both AI interviews (task and worker) end in a human-confirmed saved result via the existing conversation/review/save path, with no second AI system; (3) CANONICAL GROUPS - existing group first, new only when none fits, no duplicates for synonyms, never shown to people (PKG-031 owner rule); (4) MATCHING - hard eligibility before ranking, every collected field mapped to a real matcher consumer; (5) DISPATCH - a bounded wave to eligible workers, no duplicates, no notification after expiry/fill/cancel, human choice remains the only way an Agreement is created; and the MEASURE: persisted facts of a worker and a task provably lead to a relevant (bounded, deduplicated) opportunity notification. Explicitly NOT EX-06 by the plan's own row text: exact-message chat push ("P4 isti događaj" = EX-05), profile/account screens (EX-07), job lifecycle (EX-04), the two deferred privacy branches (EX-08), P05 reminders, HITNO, A2 push metadata, voice/TTS.
exitCriteria: Both interviews end in a human-confirmed, saved result (plan 12.5 DONE; cards A02 and B00 DONE): confirmed facts survive correction, resume and review; a confirmed worker profile is saved and real criteria change eligibility as expected; draft completion is not ACTIVE.

Classification creates no duplicates; a synonym of an existing group does not create a new group; a genuinely new or concurrent group is handled by the explicit rules (plan 12.3/12.5; PLAN.md section 3; AGENTS 3.5.1); categories stay hidden from people (AGENTS 3.5.2, PKG-031).

Matcher uses the real conditions: hard eligibility precedes ranking, unknown capability is never confirmed capability, and every collected profile/task field has a named consumer or is not collected (plan 12.2/12.4/12.6; runbook P5 Matching paragraph).

A real worker -> task -> dispatch -> application/selection run passes with positive AND negative candidates; foundation/schema or a nice AI screen is explicitly not proof (plan 12.5 DONE; J03/J15; B00 step 4).

Persisted facts lead to bounded relevant events: no repeat send of the same opportunity, none after expiry/fill/cancel, no spam when nothing matches well, a profile/availability change has a clear consequence (plan 12.5; runbook P5 Exit 'sends bounded relevant events').

Corpus report states size, failures and untested categories without claiming general perfection; failures are classified (display, controller, server fact contract, prompt/provider, geocoding) (runbook P5 items 1-2 and Exit). No pass-rate number is canonical - report only.

Authorized real-provider samples confirm core extraction/location behavior (runbook P5 Exit) - only inside an owner-agreed budget and call count; existing recordings/proofs are used first (runbook P5 item 2).

Evidence levels stay separate (SOURCE / CI / DEV_APPLIED / CLIENT_WIRED / APK_BUILT / DEVICE_PROVEN / PROVIDER_PROVEN, runbook 2.1 and plan 4.2); every applied server package has exact readback and an application receipt; the certificate digest is asserted before/after.

Recording: docs/control/redovi.json (sole tracker), osvezi.mjs, live-plan generator with --check, republished tracker; one-record format per package (plan 21.2; AGENTS section 2). Closure of the notification leg is stated at the level actually proven (in-app Inbox event vs device push) - see owner question Q2.
